title: Tupelo Honey Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutTupelo Honey ~ 19 Cypress Hill Road ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Tupelo Honey is a lovely, family friendly 2,112sf home located in Old Seagrove, with 4+ bedrooms/3.5 baths, sleeping up to 10 guests. Private heated pool (heating fee applies), neighborhood beach access within a 5-minute stroll; a 90-second walk takes you into Seaside. Pet friendly for dogs only; maximum 2 dogs allowed; breed/weight must be disclosed as booking. Please note - visitor's dogs are NOT allowed on the beach at any time in Walton County. On-street parking is not allowed; please note parking spaces below and plan accordingly. ** Need more room? Take a peek at Moondance, located next door. These two, pet-friendly homes rented together are perfect for multi-family vacations! ** Main Level: Open living area. Dining table seats 8, bar seating for 2. Fully equipped kitchen. Powder room. Laundry room. Screened porch. Covered porch. Second Level: 3 Bedrooms. 2 Baths.Screened porches. #1 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower #2 Bedroom has a Queen bed #3 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath, with tub/shower, is shared by #2 and #3 Bedrooms Third Level: 1 open bedroom, 1 bath. #4 Bedroom has 2 Double beds + Twin Trundle (2 Twins) Full bath with walk-in shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Smart TVs, board games, books Please note - Only Living Room TV has local cable. All TV's are Smart; streaming services may be viewed with guest login credentials. Distinctive Features Private heated pool (heating fee applies) 5-minute walk to beach 90-second walk into Seaside Pet friendly (Dogs only. Maximum 2 allowed; breed/weight must be disclosed) - Please note - visitor's dogs are NOT allowed on the beach at any time in Walton County. Linens (bed, bath, kitchen) provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 2 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly) 1 King bed, 2 Queen beds, 2 Double beds, 1 Trundle (2 Twins) 3 full bathrooms, powder room, iron, ironing board, 3 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor porches, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, 2 coffee makers (1 drip, 1 Kuerig), electric range, refrigerator with icemaker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (90-seconds) Grayton Beach (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
